purpose: Exploratory two-window annual check of the unchanged 28/91-day NeuralProphet recipes.

execution_contract.recipe: Same target-only trend/seasonality and 91-lag AR configurations as the completed 28/91-day screen, with direct 365-step AR output and no refitting of weights or tuning.
execution_contract.comparison: Standalone and fixed 75/25 naive/NeuralProphet blends versus seasonal naive and frozen 75/25 naive/TimesFM on identical 365-day windows.
execution_contract.window_selection: Two approximately non-overlapping complete annual windows, separated by 364 days, from the August source snapshot.
execution_contract.decision_rule: Report each window, mean WAPE, signed bias, worst-window loss and runtime. Historical two-window evidence is diagnostic only; no production promotion.
